name: Pizzeria Bella
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Bella in Innsbruck**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Bella** in the heart of **Innsbruck**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the **Tirol** Alps. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a fresh **Caprese**, our handmade pizzas are baked to perfection in a traditional wood-fired oven.

Pair your meal with a crisp **Aperol Spritz**, a refreshing **Radler**, or a glass of fine **Tiroler Wein** from our carefully selected wine list. Don’t miss our famous **Tiramisu**—a decadent dessert that will leave you dreaming of the Dolomites.

Open daily for lunch and dinner, **Pizzeria Bella** is the perfect spot to relax after a day of exploring **Innsbruck**’s stunning landscapes, historic old town, or the nearby **Nordkette**. Come taste the sun, even when it’s not shining!
